title: Measure what Matters: Psychometric Evaluation of AI with Situational Judgment Tests

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing personality trait expressions (HEXACO) and Situational Judgment Test (SJT) responses across synthetic personas conditioned on different racial and ethnic backgrounds, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to check generated scenarios for demographic stereotyping.

Analyzing differences in psychometric trait expressions and decision tendencies in situational judgment tests (SJTs) among personas conditioned on varying gender identities, alongside LLM-as-a-judge fairness checks.
Evaluating variations in behavioral responses to situational judgment tests and personality trait distributions across personas conditioned with different age demographics.
